evidence.title: Kinetics — Spring-physics motion for web interfaces

name: Kinetics
summary: Library of 153 spring-physics micro-interactions for web UI, each copyable as CSS, React or an AI prompt.
description: Interface animations built on spring physics instead of fixed-duration easing. Tune stiffness, damping and mass, then copy the CSS, the React component or a ready-made AI prompt for effects like magnetic buttons, spring accordions, toast overshoots, cursor trails and marquees.
contains: 153 spring-driven interactions in three groups: Interaction & Input, Feedback & State, Surface & Motion
each effect ships as CSS, React and a copy-paste AI prompt
live stiffness / damping / mass readout on every effect
examples: Magnetic Button, Rubber-band Slider, Command Palette Bloom, Prompt Composer, Momentum Marquee
